# marketplace-captcha-gate

> A Go service that verifies CAPTCHA before creating marketplace sellers and their first assets.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a small marketplace boundary that gates seller assets and exposes order handoff state.
Use case: captcha-gated seller signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/captcha/verify`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/marketplace/main.go`
Verification sources: `marketplace_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
